method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: WA compilation including amendments to No. 9 of 2022 (Legal Profession Uniform Law Application Act 2022 s 424, in force 1 July 2022), Evidence Act 2025 s 492(2) uncommenced, as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/mrdoc_48924.txt (retrieved 2026-09-07); Criminal Code s 169 as deposited at subjects/au/wa/criminal-code-act-compilation-act-1913 (mrdoc_49336, retrieved 2026-09-07); Interpretation Act 1984 s 5 and Legal Profession Uniform Law (WA) s 6(1) as deposited in their own subjects; no s 18 regulations and no Statutory Declarations Regulations 2023 (Cth) deposited: prescribed consular officials and Commonwealth witnesses are inputs

scope: From the seat of the declarant and of the lawyer acting as authorised witness. Affirming instead of swearing (s 5); anyone may declare about anything (s 11); 'lawyer' (admission) and 'experienced legal practitioner' (practising certificate for 2 years, s 8); who may witness a statutory declaration in WA (Schedule 2 as data, or a Commonwealth witness), elsewhere in Australia and abroad (s 12(6)); who may witness an affidavit in and outside WA, with the s 9(7) exclusion of a practitioner who took part and court authorised witnesses (ss 9(6)-(8), 10(5)); how a statutory declaration is made and witnessed, with the s 16 saving (ss 12(2)-(5), 16); what the Act says about audio or video links and electronic signing (s 7(3); silent otherwise); blind or illiterate makers (s 13); admissibility under ss 14-15; pretending to be an authorised witness (s 17, 12 months); the false-statement crimes brought in from Criminal Code s 169 (5 and 7 years). Not encoded: forms of oath (s 4), court oaths (ss 6(1), 7(1)-(2)), appointment machinery (s 10(2)-(4)), s 9(9), the affidavit's own form and signing limbs (s 9(2)-(5)), regulations, the expired COVID-19 modification of s 9, the uncommenced Evidence Act 2025 amendment.
seat: the declarant (maker of a statutory declaration or affidavit), and the lawyer acting as authorised witness
